4280.title: Host network crash investigation
4280.rootCauseOneLine: Underlying socket TOS failure unresolved; static source confirms fatal uncaught-exception paths, but the available runtime lacks the reported socket API.
4280.proposedFix: Repeat on the affected OS/runtime and identify the request/socket trigger before selecting a localized fix.
4280.caveats: Two clean-checkout probes passed on Darwin 25.6 / Node 22, not the reported Darwin 27 / Node 24 environment.
